_about: Skyline Repo's look library (Task 21): CC0 sources only (Poly Haven, polyhaven.com/license). ambientCG was unreachable from this machine on 2026-10-14, so every set is Poly Haven. tile = metres one texture repeat covers (Poly Haven's own physical size unless noted). fetch.py downloads into out/skyline-look-src/ (git-ignored); prep.py writes the game textures into Assets/JamKit/Templates/SkylineRepo/ThirdParty/. grade = (saturation, brightness) push; recolor = a named recolour in prep.py.

Plaster_White.note: real size 1 m; shown at 2 m on big cladding panels

Wood_Pine.note: real size 0.6 m; 1.2 m reads as wider boards on stall fronts

Sky_Kloofendal38d.why: a sunny afternoon: blue sky with thin high cloud round a 38-degree sun, a pure sky (no ground objects) so the far towers stand in front of it

Calathea.why: the planters' and shops' broad-leaf plant

Fern.why: low fern for the planters' edges

WetFloorSign.why: CONCIERGE's floor care: a yellow wet-floor sign in the warm-up hall and the shops
